name: H3 Generation Runtime / QC / Selection
description: Generate each CURRENT GenerationSegment through the H3 Generation Runtime boundary, defaulting to Windows-native ComfyUI MiniMax-H3 with explicit SGLang or MiniMax Cloud alternatives, persist every GenerationAttempt, run deterministic media QC, and require explicit human semantic selection before publishing GENERATED_VIDEO and GENERATION_SELECTION.
when_to_use: REPLICA has CURRENT TARGET_STORYBOARD, GENERATION_SEGMENTS and TARGET_ASSETS
when_not_to_use: Any production input is missing or STALE
The selected H3 runtime is unavailable or invalid
The user is asking for final post-production rather than generation

steps.title: 生成音画候选
steps.description: Persist ProviderJob before each local/cloud H3 runtime request and persist every successful MP4 into Studio artifact storage before QC.

steps.title: 技术质检
steps.description: Re-probe local video, validate SHA/duration/video stream/size/codec, and keep attempts separate from formal artifacts.

steps.title: 人工视觉选片
steps.description: Expose only technical PASS attempts for explicit semantic review and selection; do not infer human visual acceptance from ffprobe.

provider_rules: ProviderJob must exist before every local or cloud H3 invocation
LOCAL_COMFYUI is the default Windows runtime and uses native MiniMax-H3 nodes through /prompt, /history and /view
LOCAL_SGLANG remains an explicit Linux/private-GPU runtime using the asynchronous /v1/videos contract
MINIMAX_CLOUD is an explicit fallback and must never be entered automatically after a local failure because that could incur unexpected cost
Current local adapter uses t2va on FL2VA; Ref2VA is not enabled until real reference media is available
GenerationAttempt is never a formal Artifact and cannot enter Post directly
Persist runtime media into Studio artifact storage and persist SHA256 before Selection
Technical QC may validate media mechanics only; character/action/audio/scene quality requires explicit user review
Only technical PASS attempts can be included in a Selection candidate
completion_criteria: Every GenerationSegment has a technical PASS attempt
Every runtime invocation has ProviderJob provenance
Every selected media file is persisted in Studio storage and SHA/ffprobe verified
User explicitly accepts the semantic audiovisual selection
GENERATED_VIDEO and GENERATION_SELECTION are published together with current input lineage
failure_policy: Selected runtime unavailable or generation failure fails closed
Technical QC exhaustion fails the generation task
No formal selection before explicit user acceptance
